=== pubspec.yaml
name: shapes
=== lib/shapes.dart
import 'package:equatable/equatable.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

abstract class Shape {
  double area();
}

class Rectangle extends Shape {
  @override
  double area() => 2;
}

class Square extends Rectangle {}

class Circle extends Shape with Named implements Comparable<Circle> {
  @override
  int compareTo(Circle other) => 0;
}

mixin Named {}

class ShapeView extends StatelessWidget {
  const ShapeView({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => const SizedBox();
}

class Point extends Equatable {
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [];
}

class Loop1 extends Loop2 {}

class Loop2 extends Loop1 {}

class Plain extends Object {}

class Mixed = Shape with Named;

class Unknown extends p.Missing {}
